channel.title: Saudi Arabia passport: visa rule changes
channel.description: Destinations whose entry rule changed for Saudi Arabia passport holders, found by the daily comparison of public visa-policy sources (mainly Wikipedia). Check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Macao: Visa on arrival → Visa-free
item.description: Macao: visa on arrival before, visa-free now, for Saudi Arabia passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 12 November 2026.

item.title: Montenegro: Visa-free → Visa required

item.title: Trinidad and Tobago: Visa required → eVisa
item.description: Trinidad and Tobago: visa required before, eVisa now, for Saudi Arabia passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 13 September 2026.
